item.summary: fix(pr): substitute anchor-matching canonical wrapper for stale worktrees (#124710) A linked worktree whose base predates (or carries) wrapper changes relative to origin/main previously hit a hard refusal, even though the canonical checkout held exactly the trusted origin/main wrapper the refusal message told the operator to go run by hand. When the canonical checkout is clean and byte-identical to fetched refs/remotes/origin/main, exec it with a loud stderr notice instead; advisory dev-wrapper opt-in keeps precedence, and the refusal remains when no anchor-matching wrapper exists on disk. Also records the squash-merged stacked-branch rebase gotcha (git rebase --onto origin/main ) in the PR maintainer skill.
